identity_schema.finding_identity: (check, kind, file, key): check in ["prereg_lock", "audit_manifest", "hallthruster_pin", "h2_6_live_sources"]; file = repository-relative POSIX path, lexically normalised (posixpath.normpath of base_dir / rel), or '' ; key = string
identity_schema.pass_rule: a check passes iff it has zero findings (Python: problems == [])

kinds.MISSING: a pinned file is absent (verify_sha_map '<label>: <rel> is missing'; verify_pins 'pinned file missing: <rel>'); key = the pin label
kinds.SHA256_MISMATCH: a pinned file's bytes differ from the recorded sha256 (verify_sha_map '... sha256 ... != pinned ...'; verify_pins 'pinned file altered (re-pin deliberately): <rel>'); key = the pin label
kinds.EMPTY_PIN_SET: 'prereg lock lists no files' (file = the lock, key 'files'); 'MANIFEST lists no configs' (file = the audit MANIFEST, key 'configs')
kinds.UNPINNED: 'mandatory chemistry <c> has no pinned sha256' (file = the P5-N2 criteria, key = c)
kinds.SET_MISMATCH: 'audit snapshot <f>: rate files [...] differ between snapshot and MANIFEST' (file = hallthruster_bridge/audit/configs/<f>, key = the sorted symmetric difference as a compact JSON array, separators (',', ':'), ensure_ascii False)
kinds.VALUE_MISMATCH: hallthruster_pin: Manifest.toml <mkey> != PINNED.toml (file Manifest.toml, key = mkey in {repo-rev, version, repo-url}); Project.toml compat (file Project.toml, key 'compat.HallThruster'); h2_6_live_sources: a registered value check failed (file = its live source, key = the value-check name)
kinds.SOURCE_MISSING: h2_6_live_sources group FileNotFoundError caught ('source missing: ...' for constants, '<group> source: FileNotFoundError(...)'); file = the group source, key = the group label
kinds.SOURCE_KEY_MISSING: h2_6_live_sources group KeyError caught ('<group> source: KeyError(k)'); file = the group source, key = k
kinds.RAISED: the check let an exception escape ('check raised <Exc>: <msg>' from run_checks); file = the missing file for FILE_MISSING, else ''; key = the raised class
kinds.UNMAPPED: a Python problem string matched by no registered pattern (key = the raw string); it can never equal a Rust identity, so it always counts as a disagreement (no message is dropped)

raised_classes.FILE_MISSING: FileNotFoundError (file = the path in '[Errno 2] No such file or directory: <path>' relative to the tree root)
raised_classes.OTHER:<ExceptionName>: any other exception class (e.g. OTHER:IsADirectoryError, OTHER:SyntaxError, OTHER:IndexError)
raised_classes.UNSUPPORTED_SYNTAX: Rust-only (Python-literal extractor outside its grammar); it never equals a Python identity

python_message_map.rule: each Python problem string is matched with re.fullmatch (flags re.DOTALL) against the patterns of its check, in the order listed; the first match gives the identity; no match gives UNMAPPED

corruption_procedure.pristine_tree: T0 = `git archive --format=tar <scoring commit>` extracted into a fresh temporary directory; a sha256 manifest of every regular file of T0 is taken before the first and after the last tree (INV-03); every pinned_inputs_sha256 file must match in T0 (else INPUT_MISMATCH)
corruption_procedure.tree_construction: each tree is a fresh temporary directory replicating T0's directories with every regular file hard-linked to T0 (os.link); an operation never writes through a link: delete = os.unlink; modify = read the bytes, os.unlink, write the new bytes to a new file; mkdir only where an edge case says so; the tree is removed after both implementations ran
corruption_procedure.json_rewrite: a JSON edit loads the file with json.loads (dict order = file order), applies the registered change and writes json.dumps(obj, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + ('\n' iff the original ends with b'\n'), UTF-8
corruption_procedure.digit_edit: positions = offsets of bytes 0x30..0x39; if none, append b'\n'; else j = positions[U(tag|pos) % len(positions)] and byte j becomes 0x30 + ((byte - 0x30 + 1) % 10)

populations.PIN_PRL: sorted unique repo-relative paths sha256-pinned by check_prereg_lock in T0: hallthruster_bridge/<lock.files keys>, hallthruster_bridge/<criteria.inputs_pinned[k].file> for k in (measurement_audit, cases, transport_candidates), hallthruster_bridge/propellants/<criteria.inputs_pinned.chemistry_configs_sha256 keys>
populations.PIN_AUD: sorted unique paths sha256-pinned by check_audit_manifest in T0: hallthruster_bridge/audit/configs/<MANIFEST.configs keys>, hallthruster_bridge/propellants/<each config's rate_files keys>, hallthruster_bridge/audit/configs/<MANIFEST.case_files keys>
populations.R_LOCK: (lock, ['files', k]) for k in lock.files (file order)
populations.R_CRIT: (criteria, ['inputs_pinned', k, 'sha256']) for k in (measurement_audit, cases, transport_candidates), then (criteria, ['inputs_pinned', 'chemistry_configs_sha256', c]) for c in file order
populations.R_MAN: for each config f in MANIFEST.configs (file order): (MANIFEST, ['configs', f, 'sha256']) then (MANIFEST, ['configs', f, 'rate_files', r]) for r in file order; then (MANIFEST, ['case_files', c, 'sha256']) for c in file order

classes.name: byte flip in a pinned file
classes.operation: if the file is empty write b'\x01'; else offset = U('CC-01|i|offset') % size, bit = U('CC-01|i|bit') % 8, byte[offset] ^= 1 << bit

classes.name: wrong recorded sha
classes.operation: the recorded value becomes sha256(f'{master_seed}|CC-03|{i}|sha').hexdigest() (if equal to the old value: sha256 of the same string + '|retry'); json_rewrite

classes.target: s = 0: hallthruster_bridge/PINNED.toml, first match of (?m)^commit = "([0-9a-f]{40})"; s = 1: hallthruster_bridge/Manifest.toml, first match of (?m)^repo-rev = "([0-9a-f]{40})"
classes.operation: group 1 becomes sha256(f'{master_seed}|CC-06|{i}|commit').hexdigest()[:40] (if equal: of the same string + '|retry'); no match -> INPUT_MISMATCH

classes.target: name = pick(group names in h2_6_value_check_domain order, 'CC-07|i|check'); k = pick([2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12], 'CC-07|i|delta'); delta = 10.0 ** -k

operation.value: an int (not bool) live value v becomes v + 1; a float v becomes v * (1.0 + delta) (Python float arithmetic)

domain_and_error_parity.mapping_rule: every Python exception class / status used by the component maps to exactly one Rust error variant / status; no Rust path may return a value where Python fails, or fail where Python returns (CLAUDE.md rule 3: no silent fallbacks); the identity_schema raised_classes give the mapping

documented_divergence.statement: the Rust h2_6_live_sources additionally binds the immutable H2-6 record by sha256 (the source of its consumed values and pins): a changed or missing record fails closed (Rust finding SHA256_MISMATCH / MISSING, key 'consumed record', the value checks are not evaluated) while Python's check reads the builder's INPUTS and passes; the record is in no corruption population and no edge case touches it
documented_divergence.disposition: Rust strictly stronger; the record is immutable evidence (CLAUDE.md H2-6 rule) and the builder's own --check keeps record == builder

documented_divergence.statement: the Rust verifier does not execute or read the H2-6 builder: an edit of the builder changes Python's behaviour but not Rust's
documented_divergence.disposition: the builder is a reference file of this contract (REFUSED_REFERENCE_CHANGED) and immutable H2 v1 history; not exercised

documented_divergence.statement: abep_sim/constants.py: Rust detects only tokenizer-level Python syntax errors (unterminated string / bracket -> RAISED OTHER:SyntaxError); a deeper syntax error that ast.parse rejects is not detected, and a target statement outside the extractor grammar is UNSUPPORTED_SYNTAX
documented_divergence.disposition: fail-closed; no registered operation produces either case

documented_divergence.statement: JSON tokens NaN / Infinity / -Infinity and numbers overflowing f64 are accepted by Python's json and refused by the Rust reader (DECODE_ERROR); integers beyond 64 bits are read as f64 by Rust and as int by Python
documented_divergence.disposition: fail-closed; none occurs in the pinned inputs and a single byte flip or digit edit cannot create them from the registered files

decision_rules.per_test: D2: on every evaluated tree (CUR-00, DE-01..DE-24, the 168 seeded trees) and for every check, the Python decision equals the Rust decision and the sorted identity multisets are equal (an UNMAPPED Python message is a disagreement)
decision_rules.baseline: D1: on CUR-00 both implementations pass all four checks
decision_rules.class_exercise: D3: every class CC-01..CC-07 has at least one tree on which the Python reference fails at least one check (otherwise the class is NOT_EXERCISED and the verdict is PARITY_FAIL)
decision_rules.refusals: REFUSED_REFERENCE_CHANGED if a reference file differs from sha256_at_registration in the scoring tree; INPUT_MISMATCH if a pinned_inputs_sha256 file differs in T0, a registered operation is inapplicable or a tree fails INV-06; NOT_RUN_RUST_UNAVAILABLE if the verifier does not build with --locked
decision_rules.verdict: PARITY_PASS iff D1, D2 (all trees), D3 and INV-01..INV-06 hold, else PARITY_FAIL; ADMITTED iff PARITY_PASS and `cargo fmt -- --check` (workspace members only; never `--all`), `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace --locked` pass at the scoring commit; otherwise NOT_ADMITTED
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust becomes authoritative for these check semantics; it is NOT physics validation. Retiring ci_checks h2_6_live_sources (and the other three checks) from active CI is a separate later step after CI is re-pointed (SC-WP-12, RM-R29); this contract changes no CI workflow and no Python check
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after PARITY_FAIL only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays; no execution is discarded
decision_rules.single_scoring: the scoring master seed is spent by exactly one execution; the harness refuses to score when parity_report_v1.json exists
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, fixture or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: observables are restricted to the generic check semantics; no observable depends on H2-6 architecture content beyond the identity of a failing value check (RM-R20)
decision_rules.ledger_rule: on PARITY_PASS the report lists under ledger_update_requested: C-PROVENANCE-VERIFIER ADMITTED for the five ci_checks functions and the verify_sources check semantics, and that ci_checks h2_6_live_sources (with prereg_lock, audit_manifest, hallthruster_pin) MAY be retired from active CI in a separate later step after CI is re-pointed; migration_state_v1.json is owned by lane A1 and not edited here
